SVGMobject

Source: R/svg.R
SVGMobjectClass.Rd

Import an SVG file as vectorized mobjects. Paths, rectangles, circles, ellipses, lines, polylines, polygons, groups, <use> references, transforms, CSS and fill/stroke styles are supported; text elements are skipped with a warning, as upstream does (convert them to paths first).

The import follows upstream's steps, each a method: get_file_path() finds the file (also in the assets_dir setting, with .svg added); modify_xml_tree(doc) wraps the content in groups carrying the svg_default style and the root element's style; get_mobjects_from(doc) walks the elements and turns each shape (a list of its node, resolved style and transform matrix) into a mobject with get_mob_from_shape_element(shape), which calls path_to_mobject(), line_to_mobject(), rect_to_mobject(), ellipse_to_mobject(), polygon_to_mobject(), polyline_to_mobject() or text_to_mobject(), then apply_style_to_mobject() and handle_transform(); generate_mobject() runs these, and init_svg_mobject() caches the result under hash_seed(). move_into_position() centers and sizes it.

Usage

SVGMobject(
  file_name = NULL,
  should_center = TRUE,
  height = 2,
  width = NULL,
  color = NULL,
  opacity = NULL,
  fill_color = NULL,
  fill_opacity = NULL,
  stroke_color = NULL,
  stroke_opacity = NULL,
  stroke_width = NULL,
  svg_default = NULL,
  path_string_config = NULL,
  use_svg_cache = TRUE,
  ...
)

VMobjectFromSVGPath(
  path_string,
  long_lines = FALSE,
  should_subdivide_sharp_curves = FALSE,
  should_remove_null_curves = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

file_name

Path to an .svg file.

should_center

Center the result at the origin.

height, width

Target size; height = 2 by default like Manim.

color, opacity, fill_color, fill_opacity, stroke_color, stroke_opacity, stroke_width

Style overrides applied after import.

svg_default

Default style for elements that do not set their own: a list with color, opacity, fill_color, fill_opacity, stroke_width, stroke_color and stroke_opacity.

path_string_config

Arguments for VMobjectFromSVGPath().

use_svg_cache

Reuse earlier imports of the same file.

...

Passed to VMobject().

path_string

SVG path data, as in the d attribute of a <path>.

long_lines, should_subdivide_sharp_curves, should_remove_null_curves

Upstream's options for the OpenGL renderer's triangulation; kept for compatibility.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
SVGMobject("logo.svg")
} # }
